description: Remove one hostname from the project's embed allowlist. Idempotent — removing an entry that isn't present is a no-op. Removing the last entry turns embedding OFF (the public embed endpoint 404s the project). Morpha sends that website no request; a page on it stops loading the project. Reference: https://morphareels.ai/docs/tools#removeembedoriginorigin

origin.description: Hostname or URL to remove. Normalized the same way as add_embed_origin before matching.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.
